title: American Heart Association testifies against soft-drink removal in the Texas Senate

tellings.quote: And the American Heart Association, this is the world we live in now, the American Heart Association showed up to testify against us at the original one.

plain: Brigham Buhler, a guest who campaigned to have soft drinks removed in a measure before the Texas Senate in Austin sometime in the 2020s, says the American Heart Association, a large US charity focused on heart health, "showed up to testify against us at the original one." Buhler was there himself, and he offers it as a sign of "the world we live in now," where a health group sided against cutting soft drinks.
